display_long_description:
Step into Metapunch and unleash your fists!
This VR boxing stress-relief game lets you pummel quirky and cute Veggie Fighters with intuitive punches while enjoying real haptic feedback through a physical punching bag. Feel the impact, experience tactile and visual satisfaction, and let all your stress melt away!
🥊 Intuitive Punching Gameplay – No complex buttons! Use just your fists to aim, select, and strike!
🌎 Lovable Yet Punchable Fighters – Challenge soft, bouncy Veggie Fighters in a fun market arena. Punch them all and feel the relief!
🏆 Personal Performance Tracking – Monitor your punch count, speed, and accuracy to track your progress!
🔔 It is recommended to equip yourself with physical boxing gloves and a sandbag for the best experience!
⚠️ Disclaimer: Metapunch is an entertainment game for stress relief, not a professional boxing training tool. Please adjust your gameplay intensity based on your physical condition to avoid injury.
Ready to step into the Fruit & Veggie Arena? Strap on your Quest 3 and punch away!
